target.title: test(cron): add restart catch-up coverage for recurring command jobs
target.body: What Problem This Solves Issue #104412 reports that recurring cron jobs with payload.kind="command" are silently skipped across gateway stop/start windows. ClawSweeper identified a test coverage gap: the restart catch-up suite only covered systemEvent jobs, leaving both command job recovery paths untested. Why This Change Was Made Without test coverage for command jobs in startup catch-up, there was no way to confirm the two recovery scenarios worked correctly: A job added but never run (no lastRunAtMs) whose nextRunAtMs falls inside a stop window A job whose nextRunAtMs was already advanced past a missed slot, requiring the allowCronMissedRunByLastRun fallback path Both scenarios needed coverage regardless of whether a production bug exists on current main. User Impact No behavior change. Tests only. Proves the restart catch-up machinery correctly handles recurring command jobs in both recovery paths on current main, closing the gap ClawSweeper flagged. Evidence Both new tests pass on current main (17/17 total in the suite):

target.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models
target.body:
Closes #78573

## What Problem This Solves

GitHub Copilot Responses models can use hosted web search, but OpenClaw only exposed the managed `web_search` path, so users needed another search provider.

## Why This Change Was Made

Copilot catalog entries from OpenAI or Azure OpenAI that advertise Responses and tool calls now carry `nativeWebSearchTool`. The Copilot wrapper uses native `web_search` only for that capability and only when no managed provider is pinned. Other models keep the existing route. No OpenAI, core, or public Plugin SDK changes.

## User Impact

Supported Copilot models can search the web through the user's Copilot subscription. Explicit managed providers, tool policy, and unsupported models behave as before.

## Evidence

Exact head `ea63ab2afc` was run through the real Copilot provider wrapper and streaming Responses transport without starting the Gateway:

```text
native          tool=web_search          effort=low     http=200 terminal=stop citation=www.weather.gov
brave pinned    tool=function:web_search effort=minimal
policy denied   tool=function:web_search effort=minimal
no capability   tool=function:web_search effort=minimal
```

A current Copilot catalog probe completed `web_search_call` for all 9 OpenAI-family Responses models tested: `gpt-5-mini`, `gpt-5.3-codex`, `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.4-nano`, `gpt-5.5`, and the three `gpt-5.6` variants. `gpt-5-mini` and `gpt-5.5` returned `url_citation` output.

Validation passed: 124 changed tests, full type/lint/format/architecture checks, docs checks, `git diff --check`, and full build.
